title: Website-wide UI polish + shared UI patterns and utility refactor

requirements.summary: Unify page layout and data-state presentation across all existing routes (headers, spacing, loading/empty/error patterns, and shared UI look in light/dark).
acceptanceCriteria: Every route defined in frontend/src/App.tsx has a consistent page header pattern (title + optional subtitle) and consistent top/bottom padding.
All pages that load data show a consistent loading UI (same component/pattern) and a consistent empty state (card/panel styling, aligned CTA button styles).
Common UI elements (badges, cards, buttons, alerts) look visually consistent across pages in both light and dark mode.

file_operations.description: Create a shared PageShell layout wrapper that applies the consistent container width and top/bottom padding used across pages, so pages no longer hand-roll container/spacing.
Create a shared PageHeader component (title, optional subtitle, optional right-side actions slot) to standardize heading typography and header spacing across pages.
Create a shared LoadingState component (consistent spinner + sizing + min-height) used by all data-loading pages/components.
Create a shared EmptyStateCard component (icon/title/description/optional CTA) to standardize empty states across pages.
Create a shared ErrorStateCard component (title/description/optional retry/optional action) to standardize error states across pages.
Refactor Browse page to use PageShell + PageHeader and the shared LoadingState/EmptyState pattern where applicable (ensure consistent spacing and header styling).
Refactor My Tools page to use PageShell + PageHeader (with right-side primary action), and replace ad-hoc loading/empty panels with LoadingState/EmptyStateCard for consistent presentation.
Refactor Requests page to use PageShell + PageHeader and shared LoadingState/EmptyStateCard, ensuring consistent card/panel styling and CTA alignment.
Refactor My Rentals page to use PageShell + PageHeader and shared LoadingState/EmptyStateCard, ensuring consistent typography scale and spacing.
Refactor Rental Detail page to align with the standardized header pattern and spacing (PageShell + PageHeader), and use the shared error/empty/loading states where relevant.
Refactor Community Map page to use PageShell + PageHeader and shared LoadingState/ErrorStateCard/EmptyStateCard patterns to replace page-specific skeleton/error cards where appropriate.
Update chat panel to use the shared LoadingState and standardized empty/error panel styling so component-level states match the app-wide pattern.
Polish Landing page section spacing and heading scale to match the standardized typography/spacing patterns used elsewhere (no new routes or features).
Polish Listing Detail page layout spacing and headings to align with PageShell/PageHeader conventions, and ensure loading/empty/error states match shared components.
Polish Listing Form page header/spacing and loading/error presentation to match the shared patterns (do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui).
Polish Messaging page layout/heading/spacing and ensure any loading/empty/error states use the shared state components for consistency.
Polish Profile page header/spacing, align form section layout and any loading/error messaging to the shared UI patterns.

Adjust base typography defaults (heading scale consistency), surface/background defaults, and global spacing-related primitives (via existing Tailwind/shadcn theme variables) to make pages feel consistent in both light and dark mode.

requirements.summary: Create shared utility modules for repeated mappings/formatting (rental status presentation and rental date formatting) and replace duplicated inline logic with imports.
acceptanceCriteria: Rental status labels and badge classes are defined in a single shared module and reused wherever RentalStatus is rendered (no duplicated status maps in page files).
Common date formatting used for rentals is defined in a single shared utility and reused by rental-related pages/components.
After refactor, pages previously containing inline duplicates (e.g., MyRentalsPage) no longer define their own status label/color maps or ad-hoc date formatting helpers.

file_operations.description: Create a single shared rental status presentation module exporting status label + badge class helpers for RentalStatus rendering.
Create shared rental date/time formatting utilities (e.g., date range, long date, chat timestamp) to replace repeated ad-hoc conversions from bigint timestamps.
Remove page-local rental status maps and inline date formatter; replace with imports from the shared rentalStatusPresentation and rentalDateFormat utilities.
Remove page-local rental status maps and inline date formatter; replace with imports from the shared rentalStatusPresentation and rentalDateFormat utilities.
Remove duplicated status maps and date formatting helper; render status via shared rentalStatusPresentation and format dates via shared rentalDateFormat utilities.
Update any RentalStatus label/badge rendering and any rental date formatting to use shared utilities so messaging views match rental pages.
Update any RentalStatus label/badge rendering and any rental date formatting to use shared utilities for consistent status/date presentation.
Replace inline chat timestamp formatting with the shared rentalDateFormat utility to ensure consistent timestamps anywhere chat messages are displayed.
Ensure any displayed status label/badge styling relies on the shared rentalStatusPresentation utility (avoid local/duplicated label logic).

requirements.summary: Remove dead/duplicate map-zoom code by consolidating to a single hook and eliminating the empty placeholder hook file behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/hooks/useMapZoom.ts is no longer an empty placeholder; the project builds cleanly with no references to missing/removed symbols.
Map zoom/pan interaction logic lives in one hook (no overlapping/duplicated implementations across hooks).
TypeScript build passes without unused import/export warnings introduced by the cleanup.

file_operations.description: Delete the duplicated map transform hook after consolidating its implementation into a single clearly-named hook (to avoid overlapping implementations).
Implement the consolidated map zoom/pan hook here (using the existing behavior currently in useMapTransform), making this the single source of truth for map interactions.
Update CommunityMapPanel to import and use the consolidated useMapZoom hook, removing references to the deleted/old hook and ensuring behavior remains consistent.

requirements.summary: Standardize navigation and action patterns (CTA hierarchy, link styling, and predictable placement of key actions) across relevant pages and header navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary actions use a consistent button variant and placement pattern across pages (e.g., top-right header action on management pages like My Tools).
Secondary actions (links and outline/ghost buttons) follow a consistent hierarchy and styling across pages.
No page contains conflicting navigation patterns for similar tasks (e.g., “View Tool”, “View Details”)—labels and components are consistent.

file_operations.description: Create a shared navigation link component that encapsulates consistent link styling for header and in-page nav usage (active/hover states) while composing existing UI primitives.
Refactor header navigation links to use the shared AppNavLink for consistent link styling and predictable nav behavior across desktop/mobile.
Ensure the primary CTA (Add Tool) is consistently placed in the PageHeader actions area and uses the standardized primary button variant.
Standardize action labeling and hierarchy (e.g., consistent “View Details” label and primary/secondary variants) using shared PageHeader/action conventions and consistent Button variants.
Standardize action labeling and hierarchy (e.g., consistent “View Details” label and Button variants) to match My Rentals and Rental Detail patterns.
Align navigation/back action styling and any inline links (e.g., view listing) to the standardized link/button hierarchy so cross-page interactions feel consistent.
Align primary/secondary actions (e.g., request rental / edit / manage) to the standardized button hierarchy and ensure labels match similar actions elsewhere.
Ensure conversation selection and key actions follow the standardized CTA/link patterns and match rental-related pages for seamless cross-page interactions.

requirements.summary: Apply a neutral, modern, cohesive visual theme using the existing Tailwind + shadcn variable system and enforce consistent surfaces/typography across the app (no new features).
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent theme is visible across all pages (same surface/background treatment, consistent typography scale, consistent card and input styling).
Theme works well in both light and dark mode using the existing theme variables setup.
No new product features are introduced as part of the visual refresh—only styling and consistency improvements.

file_operations.description: Refine the existing CSS variable palette and base typography defaults to keep the theme neutral/modern (not blue/purple dominant) while improving contrast and surface consistency in light/dark modes.
Adjust Tailwind theme extensions as needed to support the refined neutral surface styles (radii/shadows/typography scale) while continuing to rely on existing CSS variables.
Ensure the global layout applies consistent background/surface treatment and that main content spacing harmonizes with PageShell usage across pages.
